commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Amine Harit (Marseille) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Marseille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+2' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Amine Harit (Marseille) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Gregoire Coudert.

88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) was quite harsh and Stephanie Frappart didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Marseille have a free kick from a promising distance.
87' Here is a change. Ludovic Ajorque is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Hamidou Makalou (Brest).
87' The current number of shots on goal is 5:4.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Amine Harit (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Mason Greenwood.
82' A cross from a corner kick by Marseille is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
82' Luis Henrique (Marseille) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Marseille have a corner.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Pereira Lage departs the field of play to be replaced by Romain Del Castillo (Brest).
77' Here comes a substitution. Jonas Martin (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Mahdi Camara.
77' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Leonardo Balerdi and he is replaced by Quentin Merlin (Marseille).
77' The substitution has been made. Derek Cornelius (Marseille) has replaced Ulisses Garcia.

77' Good chance! Quentin Merlin (Marseille) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.

76' What a chance that is! Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
76' A pass into the box finds Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Geronimo Rulli denies him.
75' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
73' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:9.
71' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hugo Magnetti will be replaced by Mama Balde (Brest).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kamory Doumbia (Brest) comes onto the pitch for Abdallah Sima.
67' Substitution. Amine Gouiri makes way for Jonathan Rowe (Marseille).
67' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Valentin Rongier is replaced by Ismael Bennacer (Marseille).
63' No offside! Referee Stephanie Frappart points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Marseille players.
63' The Marseille players joy may have been justified, because referee Stephanie Frappart is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
63' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) has a goal ruled out for offside!

63' 4 - 1 Goal! Adrien Rabiot puts Amine Gouiri (Marseille) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the bottom left corner. 4:1.
62' A corner kick by Brest is thwarted by the well prepared Geronimo Rulli (Marseille).
61' A great run from Mason Greenwood (Marseille) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
58' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is able to continue to play.
58' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

56' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
53' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
49' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Michael Murillo (Marseille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It's a throw-in for Marseille.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 3 - 1 What a goal that is! Mason Greenwood sends a brilliant cross into the box and Amine Gouiri (Marseille) scores a stunning bicycle kick goal! Wow, take a bow gentlemen. 3:1.

42' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
41' Michael Murillo (Marseille) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brest.
37' 2 - 1 Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) deflects the ball past his own goalkeeper and into the goal after trying to jump in the way of a shot!
37' Marseille quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
36' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle. A free kick to Marseille.
34' Michael Murillo (Marseille) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
32' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stephanie Frappart saw the whole situation.
25' 1 - 1 Goal 1:1! Abdallah Sima (Brest) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
25' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
25' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is about to take a corner kick.
22' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.

19' Marseille slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
16' Brest fail to score from a corner as Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.

15' Abdallah Sima (Brest) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant. The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.
15' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
14' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
13' Gregoire Coudert blocks Luis Henrique (Marseille)'s effort from the edge of the box.

8' 1 - 0 Luis Henrique sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
7' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
7' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.

2' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Abdallah Sima (Brest) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Geronimo Rulli pulls off a brilliant save.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Marseille will kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is the one to supervise the game today.
